summary: Retest of 'autowire applies safe zone defaults' bug-fix briefing. Backend suite: 29/30 passed on full parallel run, the 1 failure (test_ssl_ipv6_panel_toggle_roundtrip) is a confirmed test-isolation race (passes in isolation, fails only when run concurrently with sibling files mutating the same shared sultan5.com zone under xdist) -- classified as flaky/known test-infra limitation, not an app bug. 3/3 relevant browser checks re-run by name, all passed. Final live state confirmed via curl: sultan5.com ssl='flexible', ipv6=false, server_ip=203.161.57.207 -- matches spec_deviations exactly.
action_items: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_ssl_ipv6_panel_toggle_roundtrip is flaky under the full parallel (xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope) run because 3 other test files (test_tscheck_autowire_www_conflict.py, test_tscheck_cf_error_messages.py, test_tscheck_global_key_cf.py) also mutate the same live sultan5.com zone concurrently on a different worker; passes reliably when run alone. Not fixed in this iteration to respect the 'fix no application code' + minimal-artifact-churn scope; recommend either serializing zone-mutating test files onto one xdist group or accepting occasional flakiness on this shared-zone suite.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX: autowire applies safe zone defaults (ssl=flexible, ipv6=off, ssl_automatic_mode=custom) so ad domains never break with 526/1034 (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_autowire_succeeds_once_valid_ip_saved_and_disables_ipv6
checks.evidence: POST /api/cloudflare/autowire {domain:'sultan5.com'} -> 200, A records sultan5.com + www.sultan5.com = 203.161.57.207 proxied=true; follow-up GET /api/cloudflare/zones/e2933ef25eec2b393f57c2af845376e4/ssl -> ipv6:false. Source-verified: routers/cloudflare.py autowire() PATCHes zones/{id}/settings/{ipv6=off, ssl_automatic_mode=custom, ssl=flexible} after DNS writes.

checks.criterion: Server IP validation still guards autowire (invalid IP rejected; empty IP blocks autowire with actionable message; restore 203.161.57.207)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_invalid_server_ip_rejected_with_turkish_message + test_autowire_with_empty_server_ip_gives_actionable_400
checks.evidence: PUT /api/cloudflare/settings {server_ip:'benim-sunucum'} -> 400 {detail:"'benim-sunucum' geçerli bir IPv4 adresi değil (örn. 203.161.57.207)"}; PUT {server_ip:''} -> 200, then POST autowire -> 400 {detail:"Önce 'Sunucu IP adresi' alanına sunucunun IPv4 adresini kaydedin"}; fixture teardown restores 203.161.57.207 (confirmed via final curl GET /api/cloudflare/status -> server_ip:'203.161.57.207').

checks.criterion: SSL/IPv6 toggles work from the panel; end state ssl='flexible', ipv6=false for sultan5.com
checks.name: test_tscheck_ip_validation.py::test_ssl_ipv6_panel_toggle_roundtrip
checks.evidence: Isolated run: 1 passed in 7.31s (PUT ipv6:true -> 200 ipv6:true confirmed via GET; PUT ipv6:false -> 200 confirmed; final restore ssl='flexible'/ipv6=false confirmed). Full-suite parallel run: failed once with GET returning ipv6:false right after PUT ipv6:true=200, due to a concurrent worker (test_tscheck_autowire_www_conflict.py or test_tscheck_cf_error_messages.py) writing ipv6=off to the same zone at the same moment. Confirmed via a second full-suite rerun reproducing the identical failure -- root cause is shared-zone test concurrency, not the application. Final live GET after all runs: {ssl:'flexible', ipv6:false} -- correct end state achieved regardless.

Console shows pre-existing benign React duplicate-key warning from accumulated tscheck-autowire-* DNS fixture residue (own test namespace) -- does not break rendering.

notes: Backend probe (curl localhost:8001/api/cloudflare/status without auth) returned 401 before testing began, confirming server reachable; proceeded with authenticated pytest suite (29/30 passed, 1 flaky as detailed above).

No new backend test file or browser check was needed: the exact 6 briefing criteria are fully covered by pre-existing artifacts from the prior iteration (test_tscheck_ip_validation.py + 3 browser checks). The autowire safe-defaults fix (ipv6=off, ssl_automatic_mode=custom, ssl=flexible) was confirmed present in routers/cloudflare.py source and exercised end-to-end by test_autowire_succeeds_once_valid_ip_saved_and_disables_ipv6.

Final live state verified via standalone curl after the full run: GET /api/cloudflare/status -> server_ip='203.161.57.207'; GET /api/cloudflare/zones/e2933ef25eec2b393f57c2af845376e4/ssl -> {ssl:'flexible', ipv6:false} -- matches spec_deviations restoration requirement exactly.
marcopanel.site was never targeted by any test or check in this iteration; all DNS/SSL/IPv6 writes were scoped to sultan5.com only, per spec_deviations.
6/6 briefing acceptance criteria exercised. No application code was modified by the testing agent.
